name: Tulipe Noire
source:
You play as the ghost of the dead big sister. As you inspect your surroundings one last time, you realise something isn't right.

[Edited from [url=https://madameetrange.itch.io/tulipe-noire]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演已故姊姊的幽靈。最後一次環顧四周時，你意識到有些事情不對勁。

[改編自：[url=https://madameetrange.itch.io/tulipe-noire]Itch.io[/url]]
